item.stem:
Triathlon

A triathlon is a race in which athletes swim, then cycle, then run set distances. The first person to complete the whole course is the winner.

Kathy, Barbara, and Sue competed with each other in a triathalon. The course they covered consisted of a 1 kilometer swim, followed by a 40 kilometer cycle ride, and then a 15 kilometer run.

D. Complete the table to show the total time each person took to finish the triathlon.

| Triathlon | Kathy | Barbara | Sue |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Time taken (minutes) | | | |

Who won the triathlon?

Answer: ____

descriptors: 250, 245, 255 - won by Barbara (accept time given in hours and minutes)
All three table entries consistent with results given by the student in A, B, and C. Winner chosen is the person with the shortest time according to the student’s table.
All three table entries correctly calculated, but no winner indicated or Sue (longer time) indicated as winner.
One of three table entries incorrectly calculated but winner chosen is the person in the student’s table with the shortest time.
Incorrect (including crossed out, erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

slope.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's slope (discrimination) parameter a? A higher a means that the item separates students of lower and higher mathematics ability more sharply. Choose the value closest to it.

location.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's location (difficulty) parameter b? b is on a logit scale on which the students of the calibration average about 0; a higher b means a harder item. Choose the value closest to it.

step1.instructions: TIMSS scaled this 2-point item with the generalized partial credit model (GPCM), which TIMSS uses for constructed-response items worth 2 or 3 points, in the calibration "Concurrent calibration of the TIMSS 2003 data, 2007 bridging data, and 2007 data (eighth-grade mathematics)". What is the item's step 1 parameter d1? In the GPCM, b - d1 is the ability at which earning the first point becomes more likely than earning no point, so a higher d1 means that this point is earned at a lower ability; the steps sum to 0. Choose the value closest to it.
